name: Blue Sail Medical Co.,Ltd.
summary: Blue Sail Medical Co.,Ltd. is a global enterprise based in Zibo, China, specializing in the production and distribution of a wide array of protective gloves. Its offerings include disposable medical, latex, nitrile, PVC, TPE, and household gloves, which are utilized across various sectors such as medical examination and protection, food processing, and the electronics industry. Beyond its glove business, the company actively engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of cardiac stents and associated equipment for interventional cardiac surgery. Established in 2002, the company was formerly named Shandong Blue Sail Plastic & Rubber Co., Ltd. before adopting its current identity, Blue Sail Medical Co.,Ltd., in July 2014.
